approval_policy.label: Approval Policy
approval_policy.help: Approval policy. on-request: prompt for confirmation before every tool execution (default); untrusted: only request approval for untrusted operations; never: never prompt for approval, enabling full automation when combined with YOLO mode

sandbox_mode.label: Sandbox Mode
sandbox_mode.help: Sandbox execution mode. read-only: prohibit any filesystem writes; workspace-write: allow writes within the workspace directory; danger-full-access: no sandbox restrictions; external-sandbox: use external sandbox tools (Docker, Seatbelt, Landlock)

allow_shell.label: Allow Shell Operations
allow_shell.help: Whether shell tools are allowed. When true, shell tools are available but still controlled by the approval policy (on-request / untrusted / never); when false, the exec_shell tool is completely hidden

permissions_toml.label: Permissions TOML File
permissions_toml.help: Path to the TOML-formatted permissions rules file
